LoonNet.blurb: Four short games about the common loon's year on the Whitefish Chain, each tied to real field research.

games.title: Nest Site
games.desc: Choose a safe shoreline nesting site. Place it too high and a loon cannot reach it; place it too low and boat wake can swamp it. Discover how artificial nesting platforms can help.

games.title: Deep Dive
games.desc: Dive to feed loon chicks through a season of changing water clarity. Learn why clear water matters to sight-hunting loons and why lead tackle is such a serious hazard.

games.title: Runway
games.desc: Help a loon build enough speed across open water to become airborne. Learn why loons need a long aquatic runway and how birds can become stranded on wet pavement.

games.title: Chick Taxi
games.desc: Balance and collect while young chicks ride safely on a parent's back, in a simple browser game designed for the youngest visitors.
